author: Filmento
description:
2009's Dragonball Evolution is an awful adaptation of the manga series. So awful and hated that it became a black hole for the careers in everyone involved. The Last Airbender is actually pretty good compared to it. So in today's Lessons from the Worst, let's fly through the movie to see why it sucks and also what exactly makes it the worst adaptation of all time.
